newsitem.title: USA: R.P. Scherer, Elan in licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: R.P. Scherer, Elan in licensing pact.

text.p: R.P. Scherer Corp and Elan Corp plc said Tuesday they entered into a license and supply agreement through their affiliates, Scherer DDS and Athena Neurosciences Inc.

The agreement provides Elan with an exclusive license in North America, the United Kingdom, Ireland and certain other countries to market a patented formulation of selegiline using Scherer's proprietary Zydis technology.
Selegiline is marketed in the U.S. and other countries as a treatment for Parkinson's disease. Zydis selegiline is a fast-dissolving dosage form designed for oral administration.
R.P. Scherer develops and manufactures drug delivery systems.
